title: Modals for Asking: Permission and Help (SEAM)

vocabulary.meaning_en: a card or ticket that allows you to go somewhere or do something
vocabulary.example: I use a metro pass to take the bus.
Can I assist you with your bags?

vocabulary.meaning_en: when someone allows you to do something
to take something and give it back later
used in serious or official situations
vocabulary.example: Use formal English with your manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relaxed and informal, like between friends

vocabulary.example: We are acquainted; we work in the same office.
There is a power disparity between a boss and a worker.
Could you give me a hand with this box?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to welcome people at the door
vocabulary.example: The greeter opened the door for us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word made from the first letters of other words
vocabulary.example: PASS and PAN are acronyms in this lesson.

fine_lines.title: may I vs could I vs can I (permission)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: may I: الأكثر رسمية، مع شخص لا تعرفه أو مع من له سلطة (مدير، بنك). could I: مهذّبة مع من تعرفهم (العمل، المدرسة، الوالدين). can I: عفوية بين الأصدقاء. ملاحظة: may في طلب الإذن تأتي مع I و we فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: may I: most formal, with strangers or people with power (a boss, a bank). could I: polite, with people you know (work, school, parents). can I: casual, with friends. Note: may for permission goes with I and we only.

examples.sentence: May I borrow your phone, sir?
Dad, could I borrow the car tonight?
Hey, can I borrow that pen?

fine_lines.title: can you vs could you vs would you (help)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: can you: طلب عادي، خاصة من شخص عمله أن يساعدك. could you: أكثر تهذيبًا، عندما لا تعرف إن كان الشخص يستطيع (ليس عمله). would you (be able to): الأكثر تهذيبًا، عندما لا يجب على الشخص أن يساعدك. لا نقول May you help me?
fine_lines.explanation_en: can you: a normal request, especially when helping is the person's job. could you: more polite, when you're not sure they can (not their job). would you (be able to): most polite, when they don't have to help you. We never say "May you help me?"

examples.sentence: Can you help me find the milk?
I know it's not your job, but could you help me?
Would you be able to help me tomorrow?

expressions.meaning_en: A formal offer of help (shops, hotels).
expressions.example: Good morning. May I help you?

expressions.phrase: Can I borrow that for a second?
expressions.example: Can I borrow that for a second? Thanks.

expressions.phrase: Could you give me a hand?
expressions.example: This box is heavy. Could you give me a hand?
Would you be able to give me next Tuesday off?

expressions.phrase: I can help you with that.
expressions.example: Don't worry, I can help you with that.

grammar.title: A = Ask for a PASS
grammar.explanation_ar: في طريقة SEAM، حرف A يعني Ask for a PASS: نستخدم الأفعال الناقصة لطلب الإذن (Permission) أو المساعدة (ASSistance). التركيب: فعل ناقص + الفاعل + المصدر؟
grammar.explanation_en: In the SEAM method, A means Ask for a PASS: we use modals to ask for Permission and ASSistance. Structure: modal + subject + base verb?

grammar.title: Asking for permission: may, could, can
grammar.explanation_ar: Modal + I/we + المصدر؟ الترتيب من الأكثر رسمية إلى الأقل: may ← could ← can.
grammar.explanation_en: Modal + I/we + base verb? From most formal to least: may → could → can.
examples: Could I leave early today? (boss you know)

grammar.title: Asking for help: can, could, would
grammar.explanation_ar: Modal + you + المصدر؟ can you (عادي)، could you (أكثر تهذيبًا)، would you be able to (الأكثر تهذيبًا). لا نستخدم may مع you.
grammar.explanation_en: Modal + you + base verb? can you (normal), could you (more polite), would you be able to (most polite). Don't use may with you.
examples: Could you open the window, please?
Would you be able to check my essay?

questions.question: In "Ask for a PASS", what does ASS stand for?
You are at the bank and speaking to a manager you don't know. "___ I ask a question?"
questions.explanation_ar: may للمواقف الرسمية مع من لا تعرفه.
questions.explanation_en: May for formal situations with people you don't know.

questions.question: Which sentence is NOT correct?
questions.explanation_ar: لا نستخدم may مع you في الطلب.
questions.explanation_en: We don't use may with you in requests.

questions.question: To a friend: "___ I borrow your pen?" (casual)
Which request is the most polite?
choices: Would you be able to help me?
questions.explanation_ar: would you be able to الأكثر تهذيبًا.
questions.explanation_en: Would you be able to is the most polite.

questions.question: "Could you give me a hand?" means ___.
choices: Could you give me a gift?
questions.explanation_en: Give me a hand = help me.

questions.question: What does "borrow" mean?
choices: to take something and give it back later
questions.explanation_en: Borrow = take and give back later.
